title: A Alibi for the Confession
author: Mara Crane
blurb: Felix Sandoval, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
